englishChangesThisStage.old: Existence is sometimes necessary and sometimes contingent.
englishChangesThisStage.new: Existence is necessary in some instances and contingent in others.
englishChangesThisStage.reason: الوجود يكون واجباً ويكون ممكناً expresses the division of existence, not a thing's alternating between necessary and contingent existence at different times.

englishChangesThisStage.old: The predication between them is the predication of the cause of the effect, as sustained by the cause.
englishChangesThisStage.new: In this predication, the cause is predicated of the effect insofar as the effect is sustained by the cause.
englishChangesThisStage.reason: Clarifies the direction of حمل العلّة على المعلول متقوّماً بالعلّة. In the existing double-of phrase, “cause of the effect” could be misread as one noun phrase, concealing which term is predicated of which.

englishChangesThisStage.old: This occurs through putting on a further form after putting on a form, rather than through stripping off and putting on, as in the former case.
englishChangesThisStage.new: This occurs not by stripping off and putting on, as in the second kind, but by putting on after putting on.
englishChangesThisStage.reason: Makes the corrected cross-reference explicit and preserves the author's order; use only with disclosed adopted 1428 correction.

englishChangesThisStage.old: Non-dependence is included at the level of that upon which the other depends.
englishChangesThisStage.new: The nonexistence of what depends is included at the level of that upon which it depends.
englishChangesThisStage.reason: The later edition changes the abstract noun dependence to the dependent entity. The English change must be explicitly tied to that adopted later reading, rather than presented as a correction of an English mistranslation of the retained base.
